statusDefinitions.fixed_and_verified: A remediation is merged and covered by current verification evidence.
statusDefinitions.governance_or_owner_gated: The next action requires governance, a repository owner setting, key custody work or a future contract version.
statusDefinitions.documented_accepted_or_monitored: The condition is explicitly accepted for the current dormant configuration and must be reviewed before activation or redeployment.
statusDefinitions.open_actionable: Repository, documentation or operations work remains and can be handled without an on-chain governance action.
statusDefinitions.informational_no_action: The item records methodology, context or an optional improvement and has no required remediation.

consolidatedPdf.editorialCorrection: 2026-09-19: aggregate severity totals now follow all 82 individual finding labels; no finding text, label or technical conclusion changed.

findings.title: LendingVault activation price risk
findings.nextAction: Keep borrowing disabled; specify and audit a bounded, fresh price path with borrow caps and emergency controls before activation.
findings.verification: Oracle and cap regression tests, independent review, governed activation and post-execution chain checks.

findings.title: FeeRouterV1 IFR fees are stranded
findings.nextAction: Choose and publish an explicit sink policy or route future pool fees to a governed recoverable receiver in a future contract path.
findings.verification: Proposal tests, receiver accounting tests and post-execution balance checks.

findings.title: CommitmentVault price-conditioned locks cannot unlock
findings.nextAction: Keep price-conditioned locks disabled and design a lock guard or governed rescue path for a future version.
findings.verification: Negative lock tests, recovery tests, independent review and governed deployment evidence.

findings.title: Points SIWE verification lacks domain binding
findings.nextAction: Keep SIWE domain, URI origin, configured chain and server-issued nonce checks coupled as authentication evolves.
findings.verification: PR #107 / a8e80c7e; Points 54/54; exact-head and exact-main CI; live Points health after the fail-closed deployment.

findings.title: Points lock proof defaults to Sepolia
findings.nextAction: Keep production pinned to Ethereum mainnet, the server-managed HTTPS RPC and the canonical IFRLock, with the startup bytecode probe enabled.
findings.verification: PR #107 / a8e80c7e; fail-closed configuration tests; live chain 1 and canonical IFRLock bytecode probe; Points env mode 0600.

findings.title: Voucher signer overlaps a Safe owner key
